Some resolutions to this could include fleet operation revisions that would improve arrival SOC, extended vehicle dwell periods from reservations, or short delivery delays to ensure charge sessions have sufficient time to complete. These findings present exciting opportunities for fleets to address peak demand challenges that may be increasing utility bills or delaying expanding operations. There are many opportunities for this technology to be refined for a specific fleet’s needs. These refinements could be tested and verified using the framework outlined in this report, as well as the capabilities developed and currently present at NLR. While these results present exciting cost savings, many opportunities still remain to ensure that expanding electric loads can be supported without costly and time- consuming upgrade projects. 35 This report is available at no cost from the National Laboratory of the Rockies at www.nlr.gov/publications.
